📱 Gen-Z Slang

Practice current Gen-Z slang by matching each clue to the exact term, from rizz and delulu to doomscrolling, glazing, and rage bait.

  • What you will do: Each card gives you a vibe-heavy clue, and you type the Gen-Z slang term it is giving.
  • Timing: Study and drill screens last about 10 seconds, review screens last about 5 seconds, and correct confirmations flash for about 0.5 seconds.
  • How it works: Feedback appears right away, so if your answer is mid, not clocking, or fully cooked, you immediately see the exact term and can lock it in.
  • Why it helps: Adaptive scheduling brings back the terms that are not quite sticking yet and spaces out the ones where you already left no crumbs.

Use the clue wording, discourse context, and meme lore as your side quest map, then begin when you are ready.
